title: Mathematics Practice Test 1 - Mathematics - Inequalities and Optimization
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Given that $1 \le m \le 4$, $4 \le n \le 6$, and $8 \le p \le 10$, what is the greatest possible value for $(\frac{m}{n})(\frac{1}{p})$?
questions.explain: To maximize the fraction $\frac{m}{np}$, you must maximize the numerator $m$ and minimize the denominator $np$. The maximum value for $m$ is 4. The minimum values for $n$ and $p$ are 4 and 8, respectively. Plugging these in: $\frac{4}{4 \times 8} = \frac{4}{32} = \frac{1}{8}$.
